title: Bonnybridge UFO hotspot and stepfather's sightings

tellings.quote: he used to live in Faluk which is near Bonnybridge which is in Scotland and it's like a Scottish UFO hotspot. Had many many sightings almost like a tourist attraction. You know people go there to see UFOs

plain: Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker, tells Jesse Michels's podcast that his stepfather used to live in Falkirk, near the Scottish town of Bonnybridge. McKinnon says Bonnybridge is a Scottish UFO hotspot with so many sightings that it is almost a tourist attraction, with people going there to see UFOs. He tells it as part of how his family came to take sightings seriously.
